record.label: Capped RMS error in the low-energy window
record.statement: For every 63-electron eigenstate, the root-mean-square (RMS) error is at most 1 mHa after the true and estimated energies are capped at 0.1 Ha above the sector ground energy. For eigenstates above the window, this is a bound on the RMS shortfall below the cutoff.
record.boundary: Suppose an eigenstate has energy 5 mHa above the cutoff. An estimate 3 mHa above the cutoff gives zero capped error, since both energies are replaced by the cutoff. An estimate 2 mHa below the cutoff gives a 2 mHa shortfall. If this outcome has probability 1/4 and every other outcome has zero capped error, the RMS shortfall is 1 mHa. For an eigenstate inside the window, the true energy retains its value after capping.
